results.notes: Operating and not an excluded type. Google profile re-confirmed: 4.8, 'Computer support and services', 197 NJ-18 East Brunswick, phone (732) 675-6843, and an owner post dated November 12, 2026 (19 hours ago) about a Microsoft 365 outage linking to a page on the main domain - so the profile is active. Main domain still serves Cloudflare's 'Just a moment... / Performing security verification' page in a real Chrome at 1280px after a 6-second wait, so the blocked-site issue holds; robots.txt and sitemaps are reachable, so the block is on HTML for automated visitors rather than robots. Secondary domain loads but is thin and stale: H1 'Home', 2020-era Newspaperly theme credit, a reused 'Tweets by JaysStop' embed on Contact and Testimonials, and an empty Testimonials page. Scores left as recorded: gap 4 and evidence 4 fit a claimed, active profile pointing at a blocked site plus a duplicate thin domain; pay 3 and ease 3 are defensible, though the BDR-hiring support for pay/ease should be dropped now that the posting is dead.

Verified live: title 'Home - Key Marketing Agency', no meta description, viewport maximum-scale=1, footer '© 2020 Key Marketing Agency', six testimonials and a Verizon/Firestone/Sprint-style logo strip, Calendly phone-consult link (calendly.com/keymktg/phone-consult-general) and a working tel link to (732) 200-2889, one JSON-LD @graph block, Yoast robots.txt with 'Disallow:' and a sitemap. Address mismatch confirmed: site footer and contact page say 1 Tower Center Blvd Suite 1510 PMB 30 East Brunswick, while Google shows 485C US Highway 1 South Suite 100 with a 5.0 rating and the same phone. 390px layout is clean, no overflow, form reachable. Gap lowered 4 to 3: the site functions, books consultations and carries real social proof, so the decay is polish plus local-search hygiene rather than a broken funnel.

results.name: Kilmer Driving School
results.notes: Operating driving school (not an excluded type). Re-confirmed every top issue: https://www.kilmerdrivingschool.com/ fails in Chrome with ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID, and the HTTP version is what serves; the contact page has no form, no address and no phone in text (only the logo image links tel:732-895-2911); the footer reads '(c) 2016 Kilmer Driving School'; default WordPress sidebar widgets (Recent Comments, Archives, Categories, Meta, Log in) are still exposed; the fetched HTML has no meta description and no JSON-LD. The services page confirms $390 six-hour course, $50 permit fee, $160/$240 road-test packages, 'Office Visits by Appointments Only', a 24-hour cancellation request and License #000293. Google listing: 4.9 'Driving school', 646 NJ-18, closes 5 PM. One added finding that strengthens the record: Google's phone for the listing is (732) 955-6552, so the site's tel: link points to a number that does not match the profile - worth calling out to the owner. Minor imprecision: the 'instructors speak English, Spanish and Arabic' signal is on the home page, while the cited /services/ page says English and Arabic only. Review count of 1,089 could not be re-read in Google's limited Maps view. Scores reasonable as recorded (gap 5, pay 3, ease 3, evidence 3).

results.name: Fotoplicity

wrong_claims.claim: No online self-serve booking and no calendar exists - 'every inquiry routes to a form or phone call'; 'site uses book language but no calendar exists'
wrong_claims.what_is_true: The headshots page has a 'Schedule A Phone Call' link into the Fotoplicity client portal scheduler (clientportal.fotoplicity.com), which offers a 15-minute phone consultation with pickable slots (Nov 17, 2026, 1:00-3:00 PM shown). A visitor or agent can pick a time online; what does not exist is self-serve booking of a paid photo session or a deposit.

wrong_claims.what_is_true: A calendar-based appointment scheduler exists one click from the headshots page and should have been seen; only session/deposit booking is missing.

results.notes: Operating, solo-owner portrait studio, not an excluded type. Verified: title is just 'Fotoplicity'; meta description does name the East Brunswick studio; three JSON-LD blocks including a LocalBusiness whose openingHours string is malformed ('Mo 09:00-12:00, Tu 09:00-12:00, , Th 09:00-12:00, Fr 09:00-12:00, , '); Squarespace robots.txt disallows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, anthropic-ai, CCBot and others while leaving OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot and Googlebot allowed; contact page carries a Flodesk form, tel:+1739177748, '180 Tices Lane, Building A, Suite 103', the 24-hour reply promise and the 'limited number of families each month' line. The 'Book a ...' buttons on the home page link to service pages, not a scheduler. 390px layout is legible but the hero is a very faded photo with a large blank band before the headline. Gap lowered 3 to 2 and evidence 4 to 3 because a bookable consultation path exists and the record missed it; bookable should arguably be 2 rather than 1.

results.notes: Operating small contract packager, not an excluded type (YellowPages, Macrae's and a D&B entry all list it; nothing suggests closure). Core issue re-confirmed directly: https://www.elitepkg.net/ returns a bare '403 Forbidden - You don't have permission to access this resource' in real Chrome, so there is no crawlable content, no quote form and no visible phone or email; robots.txt is equally inaccessible. The 4.0 Google listing at 40 Cotters Ln is very likely the same firm (listings variously give 21 and 40 Cotters Lane; matching name and street, so this is an inference, not confirmed), which adds a concrete claim-and-complete action and a small review history to the opportunity. Evidence score 3 remains fair: the site itself could not be read, so service descriptions rest on directories and search-indexed copy. Gap 5, pay 2 and ease 4 look reasonable.

Everything else checked holds: title 'Parkway-Kew | Precision Wear-Resistant Coatings Since 1952', descriptive meta description, Organization + WebSite + LocalBusiness + FAQPage JSON-LD with telephone, foundingDate 1952 and 2095 Excelsior Ave North Brunswick, hours 'Mon to Fri, 8 am to 5 pm ET' as text, two labelled quote forms (5 and 8 fields, no CAPTCHA, no file input) inviting 'Drawings, dimensions, or a part number', robots.txt 'Allow: /' with sitemaps. Google listing confirmed unclaimed - 'Claim this business', category 'Machine shop', phone and website present, no rating, 'Add hours' prompt. Minor: the record's quoted 'send a drawing, dimensions, or a brief description' is a paraphrase of 'Phone, email, or send a drawing.' and 'Drawings, dimensions, or a part number.' Drop the mobile-contrast opportunity or replace it with the sub-headline contrast. Scores unchanged: gap 2, pay 4, ease 4, evidence 4 still fit, though evidence could be 3 given one of the three issues was misread.

data_gaps: Google's limited Maps view never exposed review counts, so counts cited in the records (Kilmer 1,089; Prestige's 192-448; Key Marketing) could not be re-verified - ratings and listing details were.

Kilmer Driving School could not be rendered in Chrome at all (ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID, and the HTTP fallback refused to load in the browser profile), so its layout, mobile behaviour and click-to-call rendering were checked only from raw HTML and readable extracts.

Elite Packaging's site returns 403 to every client used, so its page copy (including the 'under construction' text) and any phone/email on the site could not be confirmed first-hand; the Google listing 'Elite Packing' at 40 Cotters Ln is treated as the same business by inference from name and street, not confirmed.

The main domain loyaltechsecurity.com's actual content could not be viewed (Cloudflare challenge), so the record's judgements about that site's design, forms and mobile layout are untestable; I could not test whether Googlebot or AI crawlers specifically are allowed through.

Whether Prestige Nails reviews complain about waiting could not be confirmed from the only review source opened (an aggregator summary page); the underlying review text was not reachable without deeper navigation.
The Loyal Tech BDR job posting is gone from both job boards checked (410 and 404), so whether the company is currently recruiting is unknown.
